title: Bloomers
html_source: The thought about the Bishop preaching about bloomers immediately brings Molly’s thoughts back to Bloom.

anchor.prefix: o swinging my hat that old Bishop that spoke off the altar his long preach about womans higher functions about girls now riding the bicycle and wearing peak caps and the new woman
anchor.suffix: God send him sense and me more money I suppose theyre called after him I never thought that would be my name Bloom when I used to write it in print to see how it looked on a visit
